versions.content: Provide Rapid Prototyping Support Type: valid Description: The BSWMDT shall contain a support format for the description of rapid prototyping data, which can be used to generate the data descriptions required by rapid prototyping tools. Rationale: For the code generated by the RTE, the contained rapid prototyping mechanism shall be described in order to allow rapid prototyping tooling to interact with the RTE. Dependencies:  Use Case: The RTE generates support data for rapid prototyping as part of its own BSWMD. Supporting Material: 
